customer_name: Institute of Zoology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院动物研究所)
business_problem: Ecology researchers needed a less labor-intensive way to identify species and monitor pests, because traditional field research required heavy equipment, manual note-taking, specialist classification skills, and long travel or collection cycles that limited scale and talent participation.
solution_summary: Researchers at the Institute of Zoology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, together with related university partners, used Baidu AI Cloud tools to modernize biodiversity and forestry workflows. Lin Congtian built the 'BioLog' platform on the Baidu Brain open platform so field researchers can photograph a species and immediately identify it while capturing time, location, and habitat information that used to require bulky gear and manual note-taking. The same application also invites bird enthusiasts to upload pictures, which turns public participation into additional labeled data and a broader biodiversity resource base. In a related ecological workload, Professor Sun Yu's team adopted PaddlePaddle to automate red turpentine beetle counting after earlier tooling lacked localized support. PaddlePaddle's Chinese documentation, responsive engineering support, and hardware tuning helped the team move from week-long collection cycles toward high-frequency automated monitoring. Together, these AI workflows transformed ecology from isolated manual fieldwork into a more data-rich, collaborative, and automated research process.

solution_components.name: Baidu Brain Open Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the AI capabilities used to build BioLog for species identification and field-data capture.

solution_components.name: BioLog
solution_components.role: Lets field researchers and bird enthusiasts identify species from photos while recording time, location, and habitat metadata.

solution_components.name: PaddlePaddle
solution_components.role: Supports the localized model training and deployment used in ecological monitoring tasks such as bark-beetle counting.

data_flow: Photos and field observations are captured through BioLog and enriched with time, location, and habitat data, public uploads expand the biodiversity training corpus, and PaddlePaddle-based ecological models process monitoring data for tasks such as pest counting and automated field alerts.
business_outcome: The research teams reduced manual field effort, accelerated species and pest monitoring, expanded public participation in biodiversity observation, and created a stronger digital base for ecological research.
metrics: data collection moved from once a week to once an hour
architecture_clues: The work combines expert field use and public crowdsourcing in the same biodiversity data loop.
PaddlePaddle was selected partly because localized documentation, service, and hardware support mattered for long-term deployment.
The same AI adoption wave spans species identification and forestry pest monitoring rather than a single ecology subdomain.
evidence_quotes: Lin Congtian began using the Baidu Brain open platform in 2017 and developed the AI platform called BioLog for biodiversity work. (original: 2017 年，林聪田开始利用百度大脑开放平台探索在物种多样性领域的开发与创新，研发出一个名为“生物记”的人工智能平台。)

With BioLog, a field worker can take a picture, identify the species, and record the time, exact location, and habitat information immediately. (original: 当一位野外工作人员拍下一张照片时，他就能随时通过“生物记”去快速识别，并记录物种出现的时间、精确的位置信息及生存环境信息。)
The public can upload bird photos into the app, which both expands training data and popularizes biological science. (original: 鼓励鸟类爱好者将拍摄到的图片上传到 App 里...这样既能增加可以训练的数据，同时又能普及生物科学。)

Sun Yu switched to PaddlePaddle in 2018 because local support, Chinese documentation, and hardware assistance fit his ecology work better. (original: 在遇到本地化服务不足等问题后，他在 2018 年选择了百度深度学习平台飞桨（PaddlePaddle）。丰富的中文资料、高效的服务团队以及完善的硬件设施让其更加笃定飞桨对中国的开发者更加友好。)
Pest-counting work that used to be collected once a week can now be counted once an hour with accuracy above 90%. (original: 以前一周统计一次的数据现在已经可以实现一小时一次，而且准确率更是达到了 90% 以上。)
